summary:
Reviewed the exact base->head candidate (base 803f15575196827effa5914f31db2ae4b9da5674, head 2d12ecc20843fbd9c92af7dc07f95563fff83b59, whose blobs match the manifest: static/models.html bba458bd..., tests/static-assets.test.ts 072538f5...). The change replaces the models hero lead copy with 'Model catalog. Cataloged text models and the providers that list them. Availability and quota vary by provider; a catalog entry does not guarantee inference availability or remaining quota.' and adds two matching assertions to the existing 'models page labels provider counts as catalog entries' test. What I verified (read-only git/spot reads, no builds or formatters): (1) Scope is exactly the two manifest paths; no stray edits, no trailing whitespace or unusual bytes (od-checked), and the new markup splits the start tag only between '', so the rendered text is unchanged by whitespace collapsing and the tag stays valid. (2) Formatting: static/*.html is owned by deno fmt and checked in CI with lineWidth 120; the same 'long text

' shape already exists in fmt-gated files (static/admin.html line 862 'data-quota-scope', and chat.html's split tag), and long unwrapped text lines exist throughout static/*.html, so the new layout is consistent with what the formatter keeps, and the 215-char text line follows existing precedent. (3) Tests: the two new assertions match the candidate text exactly ('Cataloged text models and the providers that list them'; the \s+ between 'guarantee' and 'inference' still matches the committed single space) and remain meaningful (those phrases appear nowhere else in the repo). No other test or check pins the removed single-line form ('

Model catalog. Availability and quota vary by provider.

'): repo-wide greps for data-lead, 'Model catalog', 'Availability and quota vary by provider' show only models.html, models.css styling, and this test. (4) Copy accuracy: the restored wording is the project's own previously shipped repair copy (commit b5406c45, replaced incidentally by the Passport redesign in 4b6b1ae5), and it matches the page's own meta description and the page's rendered data (per-row provider badges from model.providers plus provider catalog sources); the page correctly shows catalog entries rather than live availability, matching models.js ('N cataloged model(s)', 'cataloged models' / 'catalog unavailable') and the test's intent. The disclaimer also aligns with docs guidance that catalog/`/v1/models` entries are not availability guarantees. (5) No gate conflicts found: file-size ratchet caps (60 and 823 lines) are far below limits, Prettier printWidth 160 is satisfied by the added test lines, and no ESLint/sonarjs rule is triggered by the added regex literals. No introduced defect identified.
